newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING--Novel Denim Holdings Ltd.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING--Novel Denim Holdings Ltd.

text.p: Novel Demin Holdings Ltd filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering for up to 3,750,000 ordinary shares.
The price of the initial stock offering is estimated between $15 and $17 per share.

Of the total amount, three million shares are being offered in the United States and Canada and 750,000 shares are being offered outside the U.S. and Canada. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 9,437,500.
Of the 3,750,000 million shares 937,500 shares are being offered by the company and 2,812,500 shares are being offered by selling shareholder, Novel Apparel (BVI) Ltd.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 562,500 additional ordinary shares. The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Montgomery Securities and Smith Barney Inc.

Proceeds will be used to repay all outstanding long-term debt. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes, including an estimated $2.2 million in connection with the leasing of an additional denim garment manufacturing facility in Madagascar.
The company has applied to Nasdaq to trade under the stock symbol "NVLD".
Novel Denim, based in Kowloon, Hong Kong, is a low cost, vertically-integrated supplier of both high-quality denim garments and fabric primarily to the European Community.
